audit_tooling.note: dedicated MCP wrappers on_page_lighthouse / on_page_instant_pages were unavailable in this environment; called the DataForSEO REST endpoints directly with for_mobile=false to preserve desktop comparability

environment_caveats.detail: Cloudflare Pages preview injects x-robots-tag: noindex on *.pages.dev, so the Lighthouse is-crawlable audit scores 0 and deflates the SEO category to 69 on all 6 URLs. SEO is recorded as-is but EXCLUDED from verdicts per methodology Step 4. is-crawlable is therefore omitted from per-URL lighthouse_issues.
environment_caveats.seo_status: inconclusive - staging noindex artifact, re-audit after apex cutover

environment_caveats.detail: floodsolutionsinc.com still serves the client's legacy WordPress site (x-powered-by: WP Engine, 301 to www). The Rank AI build exists only on the staging Pages preview, so no apex audit is possible yet.

clients/flood-solutions-inc.json has status=onboarding, not active. Methodology pre-flight expects active; audit proceeded because build_status=pushed_main means the build is live and auditable. Flagged, not modified.

Monorepo source (sites/flood-solutions-inc/src/lib/brand.ts) already carries the healed canonicalUrl https://floodsolutionsinc.com and imagesBase https://images.floodsolutionsinc.com (commit a33216866), and public/images/*.webp exist locally. The deployed preview still serves the pre-heal .invalid host and 404s those images, so the live artifact lags the source.

url-plan.json has no service-area page with primary:true, and the primary area from plan-input.json (macomb-mi) has no page in the plan. Fell back to the first service-area entry in the plan, /service-areas/sterling-heights-mi/ (all 8 share priority 4.8).
Issues surfaced by direct HTML inspection rather than a vendor audit are prefixed rankai: so they are never mistaken for real Lighthouse or DataForSEO check IDs. Each issue carries a source field.
